beats: 📺 Salvatore killed Hummice out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 1 rounds, 13 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We've been thinking. You know things we don't. Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3). We will watch very closely, which is our entire personality."
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
The System's gifts are hungry: -50 kcal metabolic cost. Feed the power or lose it.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
🩹 Salvatore makes rounds — Jesse gets bound up properly. (58 → 73 HP)
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Violet Pang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

lines: 🕯️ Violet Pang is dead — dehydration. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Elena blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Violet Pang, 12 days. The mantle passes to Elena Petrova.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elena Petrova, 44 — a Baker. Her hands know different work now: Secret Ingredient, Steady Hands.
You walk back into Haven — 6 days gone. The fire's still going. Somebody looks up from the work and nods. Back is back.
While you were gone — 8 things you missed:
🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Lena (-36 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Dieter (-57 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
⚔️ Caleb stood down the Nightlight and kept walking — 4 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Abraham killed the Lockpick alone — 2 rounds, 15 taken. Word travels fast. Took Audience token off the body. The village cheers.
⚔️ Vasyl stood down the Night Court and kept walking — 1 round, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
...and 3 more. Ask around — they'll tell you.

You start in on White Oak Acorns, Wild Black Cherry, Wild Ginger, Wild Ramps, Chickweed, Wood Sorrel, Lamb's Quarters too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Dieter showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
💬 The village saw the sky split.
You were out when it happened. When you return, everyone's talking at once. Dieter is crying. Abraham is laughing. Jesse hasn't said a word.
Nora: "The sky just... opened. And something talked to us. It said it was sorry. SORRY for what?!"
Leo: "It offered me something. A... gift? I said no. I don't trust gifts from the sky."
Lena: "..." (Lena hasn't spoken since it happened.)
The village looks to you. You're the scholar. You're supposed to know things.
Nora looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.
